verdict.rationale: monday.com's first-party marketing says its in-product agents surface insights from user data, flag risks and progress gaps, and generate scheduled status and performance reports. Together these cover AI-generated insights and suggestions inside the product. The evidence is marketing-level taglines without detail or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how insights and suggestions are generated from board data, independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Surface deep intelligence and actionable insights from any subject.
Spot risks and progress gaps before they become problems.
Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
Build agents for your exact needs. Define the goal, set the rules, watch the results.
